title: 扌 hand (提手旁)
intro: 扌 is the squeezed form of 手 (hand) and sits on the left. It is written in three strokes: horizontal, vertical hook, then a rising stroke. Characters with 扌 are actions you do with your hands: hit, push, pull, carry, hang. When 手 sits at the bottom it keeps its full form, as in 拿 (ná, take).

ex.p: tā zài dǎ diàn huà nǐ děng yī xià
ex.en: He's on the phone, wait a moment.

ex.p: zhōu mò wǒ zài jiā dǎ sǎo fáng jiān
ex.en: On weekends I clean my room.

ex.zh: 我找了半天，终于找到钥匙了。
ex.p: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān zhōng yú zhǎo dào yào shi le
ex.en: I looked for ages, and finally found the keys.

ex.p: lǎo bǎn nǐ hái méi zhǎo wǒ qián ne
ex.en: Boss, you haven't given me my change yet.

ex.p: qǐng bāng wǒ bǎ mén tuī kāi
ex.en: Please help me push the door open.

ex.zh: 把你的衣服挂在这儿吧。
ex.p: bǎ nǐ de yī fu guà zài zhèr ba
ex.en: Hang your clothes here.

ex.p: qǐng bǎ mén lā kāi
ex.en: Please pull the door open.

ex.p: qǐng bǎ mén lā kāi
ex.en: Please pull the door open.

ex.p: qǐng bāng wǒ bǎ mén tuī kāi
ex.en: Please help me push the door open.

ex.zh: 你可以给我推荐一个饭馆吗？
ex.p: nǐ kě yǐ gěi wǒ tuī jiàn yī gè fàn guǎn ma
ex.en: Can you recommend a restaurant?

ex.p: bào qiàn wǒ lái wǎn le
ex.en: Sorry, I'm late.

ex.p: mā ma bào zhe hái zi
ex.en: Mom is holding the child.

ex.zh: 我想提高我的汉语水平。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng tí gāo wǒ de hàn yǔ shuǐ píng
ex.en: I want to improve my Chinese.

ex.p: wǒ men tí qián shí fēn zhōng dào ba
ex.en: Let's arrive ten minutes early.

ex.p: zhèr kě yǐ huàn qián ma
ex.en: Can I exchange money here?

ex.zh: 这件衣服太大了，能换一件吗？
ex.p: zhè jiàn yī fu tài dà le néng huàn yī jiàn ma
ex.en: This is too big, can I exchange it?

ex.zh: 飞机几点到？我去机场接你。
ex.p: fēi jī jī diǎn dào wǒ qù jī chǎng jiē nǐ
ex.en: What time does the plane land? I'll pick you up at the airport.

ex.p: tā de diàn huà wǒ méi jiē dào
ex.en: I missed his phone call.

ex.zh: 把你的衣服挂在这儿吧。
ex.p: bǎ nǐ de yī fu guà zài zhèr ba
ex.en: Hang your clothes here.

ex.p: zài zhōng guó kàn bìng yào xiān guà hào
ex.en: In China, you register first to see a doctor.

ex.zh: 他用手指指了指那个人。
ex.p: tā yòng shǒu zhǐ zhǐ le zhǐ nà gè rén
ex.en: He pointed at that person with his finger.

ex.p: nǐ néng bāng wǒ men pāi zhāng zhào ma
ex.en: Could you take a photo of us?

ex.p: dà jiā dōu pāi shǒu huān yíng tā
ex.en: Everyone clapped to welcome him.

texts.title: 读一读 · 扌 hand (提手旁)

lines.zh: 今天早上，我去机场接我的朋友小王。
lines.p: jīn tiān zǎo shang wǒ qù jī chǎng jiē wǒ de péng you xiǎo wáng

lines.zh: 飞机晚了一个小时，我在机场找了一个咖啡馆，一边喝咖啡一边等。
lines.p: fēi jī wǎn le yī gè xiǎo shí wǒ zài jī chǎng zhǎo le yī gè kā fēi guǎn yī biān hē kā fēi yī biān děng

lines.zh: 小王出来以后，我们拥抱了一下。
lines.p: xiǎo wáng chū lái yǐ hòu wǒ men yōng bào le yī xià

lines.zh: 他说：“抱歉，让你等了这么长时间。”
lines.p: tā shuō bào qiàn ràng nǐ děng le zhè me cháng shí jiān

lines.zh: 然后我们在机场门口拍了一张照片。
lines.p: rán hòu wǒ men zài jī chǎng mén kǒu pāi le yī zhāng zhào piàn
